transferProblems.problem: Eight of twelve npm packages published before a timeout. What may a retry do?
transferProblems.answer: Reclassify every exact name/version against the registry. Skip only versions whose registry integrity matches the recorded candidate digest, continue only absent versions whose dependencies are complete, and block any conflicting digest.

transferProblems.problem: The RC includes a package that has never existed on npm. Is an rc dist-tag sufficient protection for latest?
transferProblems.answer: No. Changesets documents a first-publish latest hazard. Keep the rehearsal local or require a separately authorized and verified bootstrap strategy before any real-registry RC action.
